messages:
sarah: Heads up — nightly SAST flagged a bunch of noisy findings for payment-service and the CI job shows a KMS decrypt 403. Might be related to the RBAC tweak last week. Anyone seen this?

mike: Hmm saw some scan noise last night but not a 403. Can you paste the failing job id and a log snippet?

sarah: job id: build/5602. Excerpt from the runner log:
```
ERROR: access denied: kms:Decrypt for service-account-ci@redwood. Status=403
GET /artifacts/payment-123.tar.gz -> 403
Trace: scanner fetch-artifact failed
```

amal: That looks like the scanner runner lost permission to pull artifacts. We rotated some scanner roles during rollout and switched to ephemeral tokens — possible the new binding omitted kms:Decrypt for the CI service account.

security-bot: Alert: nightly-sast payment-service — 42 findings (high:1, medium:7). See https://redwood.sec/alerts/5602. Added tag `cloud:artifact-403`.

julia: If the scanner can't fetch complete artifacts it'll parse partial ASTs and produce false positives. We should treat these findings as "incomplete evidence" until artifacts are accessible.

mike: @amal can you confirm which IAM change removed kms:Decrypt? Also can infra add an audit log filter for artifact fetch failures so we can correlate?

amal: Confirmed: we rolled scanner-helper role on 2026-03-18 and the policy change accidentally removed the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` binding for the CI SA. Repro command: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json | jq .bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter")` — missing the CI service-account entry. Working on a fix now.

sarah: Triage plan: 1) mark current findings as pending-evidence 2) temporarily re-run SAST with `--skip-remote-fetch` (use local clone) to separate true results from noise 3) restore role and re-run nightly. Who can flip the labels and re-run?

julia: I'll add `sast:pending-evidence` to the affected PRs and create an evidence-bundle task. I can kick the local re-runs for the top 7 PRs.

mike: Follow-ups: open a PR to restore kms:Decrypt to scanner-helper role, add an automated IAM binding test in the infra CI job, and update the runbook — on artifact-fetch 403 -> escalate to infra oncall and attach `cloud:artifact-403` metadata.

amal: Patch PR opened (infra/PR#1247) to re-add the binding and a unit test. Also adding a Cloud Logging sink for `resource.type="artifact_bucket" severity>=ERROR` so we surface fetch failures.

devops: Rolled back to previous role policy at 09:12 UTC (applied infra/PR#1247). CI re-run queued at 09:20 UTC. Oncall notified.

sarah: Great. If the re-run still shows 403 we'll escalate to an incident and draft a short postmortem. For now, sec team will validate which findings are legit after the successful re-run. Closing loop once CI passes. Thanks all!
